title: 可 Q (Q on earth?)
longExplanation: Q on earth?. Pinyin: kě Q

examples.sentence: 下个星期就要去使馆办签证了，这可怎么办？
examples.romanization: xiàgèxīngqī jiùyào qù shǐguǎn bàn qiānzhèng le， zhè kě zěnmebàn？
examples.translation: I am going to the embassy to apply for a visa next week, what on earth am I supposed to do?

examples.sentence: 这可是个大问题，我也不太清楚。
examples.romanization: zhè kěshì gè dà wèntí， wǒ yě bù tài qīngchu。
examples.translation: Now this (this indeed) is a big question, and I am not too sure about it.

title: 怕/害怕 (to be afraid)
longExplanation: to be afraid. Pinyin: pà/ hàipà

examples.sentence: 我的工作经验还比较少，那份工作我怕/害怕完成不了。
examples.romanization: wǒ de gōngzuò jīngyàn hái bǐjiào shǎo， nà fèn gōngzuò wǒ pà/ hàipà wánchéng bùliǎo。
examples.translation: My work experience is still relatively small, I am afraid the job cannot be completed.

title: 恐怕…… (I guess I’m afraid…)
longExplanation: I guess I’m afraid…. Pinyin: kǒngpà……

examples.sentence: 听完我的回答，恐怕你已经知道我的答案了吧。
examples.romanization: tīng wán wǒ de huídá， kǒngpà nǐ yǐjīng zhīdào wǒ de dá'àn le ba。
examples.translation: After listening to my response, I guess I’m afraid you already know the answer.

title: 怕/恐怕 V (probably I’m afraid)
longExplanation: probably I’m afraid. Pinyin: pà/ kǒngpà V

examples.sentence: 他离开这里怕/恐怕有二十天了。
examples.romanization: tā líkāi zhèlǐ pà/ kǒngpà yǒu èrshí tiān le。
examples.translation: He left here for probably 20 days (I’m afraid).

examples.sentence: 今天我一定陪你逛街逛到底，保证让你买到合适的衣服。
examples.romanization: jīntiān wǒ yīdìng péi nǐ guàngjiē guàng dàodǐ， bǎozhèng ràng nǐ mǎi dào héshì de yīfu。
examples.translation: Today I will go shopping with you to the end. [I can] guarantee that you will buy the right clothes.

title: 到底 Q (in the world)
longExplanation: in the world. Pinyin: dàodǐ Q

examples.romanization: dàodǐ nǐ zěnme dǎsuàn de ya？
examples.translation: What in the world are you planning?

title: 拿……来说 (take… for example)
longExplanation: take… for example. Pinyin: ná…… láishuō

examples.sentence: 拿我来说，我已经学了十年汉语了。
examples.romanization: ná wǒ láishuō， wǒ yǐjīng xué le shí nián Hànyǔ le。
examples.translation: Take me, for example, I’ve been learning Chinese for 10 years.

title: 敢 V (to dare to V)
longExplanation: to dare to V. Pinyin: gǎn V

examples.romanization: shéi yě bù gǎn shuō tā de huàihuà。
examples.translation: No one dares to say bad things about her.

examples.romanization: wǒ gěi nǐ dǎo bēi shuǐ ba。
examples.translation: I will pour you a glass of water.

examples.romanization: “ wǒ ài nǐ”， dǎo guòlái jiùshì“ nǐ ài wǒ”。
examples.translation: “I love you” said in reverse is “you love me.”

title: S 倒 V (although S V)
longExplanation: although S V. Pinyin: S dǎo V

examples.sentence: 你说得倒是容易，做起来可就难了！
examples.romanization: nǐ shuō dé dàoshi róngyì， zuò qilai kějiù nán le！
examples.translation: Although you say [it as if] it is easy, it’s hard to do it!
